external_truth.system: The observed SPEC.json revision and Git base commit
external_truth.desired_outcome: Each enabled work item reaches verified Git state without giving authority to a fallible worker
external_truth.observation: Read and hash SPEC.json, read the current Git commit, and read SQLite execution state before each comparison

identity_fields: canonical work item digest for achieved-state identity
full SPEC digest for active-run fencing

domain_states.name: ready
domain_states.meaning: The desired item is eligible for a bounded attempt

domain_states.name: active
domain_states.meaning: One current fenced run owns the item

domain_states.name: achieved
domain_states.meaning: A verified candidate was promoted for the observed canonical work-item revision

domain_states.name: blocked
domain_states.meaning: Policy or repeated failure prevents automatic progress

domain_states.name: superseded
domain_states.meaning: The current SPEC no longer requests the item

execution_states.name: leased
execution_states.meaning: The controller created a fenced claim

execution_states.name: executing
execution_states.meaning: The agent can change only the isolated worktree

execution_states.name: promoting
execution_states.meaning: Fresh reads passed and local promotion is in progress

execution_states.name: awaiting-promotion
execution_states.meaning: A verified candidate is in a stable manual-promotion handoff

execution_states.name: succeeded
execution_states.meaning: The verified candidate reached the base repository

execution_states.name: failed
execution_states.meaning: The attempt ended without semantic success

execution_states.name: stale
execution_states.meaning: Authority expired or observed desired state changed

ownership_failure_boundaries.owner: One current owner token and generation in the SQLite state database for the resolved base repository
ownership_failure_boundaries.failure_domain: Concurrent or restarted controllers can share a state database and base repository
ownership_failure_boundaries.authority_loss_behavior: Reject scheduling mutations and promotion unless the controller owner, repository, generation, and lease time are current

ownership_failure_boundaries.owner: SPEC.json at its observed full SHA-256 digest, with each item identified by its canonical SHA-256 digest
ownership_failure_boundaries.failure_domain: A worker can read but cannot redefine the requested outcome
ownership_failure_boundaries.authority_loss_behavior: Stop an active child, dispatch, evaluation, or promotion and mark the run stale

ownership_failure_boundaries.failure_domain: A process exit or worker message cannot directly set semantic success
ownership_failure_boundaries.authority_loss_behavior: Stop an active child and reject the event unless the run id, generation, state, and lease are current

ownership_failure_boundaries.failure_domain: The agent owns edits only in its worktree
ownership_failure_boundaries.authority_loss_behavior: Stop an active child, preserve the candidate, and refuse promotion after base movement

ownership_failure_boundaries.owner: Committed Git comparison and constrained SQLite records
ownership_failure_boundaries.failure_domain: A worker or controller value cannot define its own rank or promotion decision
ownership_failure_boundaries.authority_loss_behavior: Reject an inconsistent quality vector, nondeterministic rank, or promotion decision that does not refer to the selected commit

reconciliation.observation: Load the current SPEC, Git commit, controller lease, work items, runs, leases, and event history
reconciliation.comparison: Acquire current controller ownership, then find an eligible desired item that has no current run and remains below its attempt limit
reconciliation.action: Renew controller ownership, create a generation-fenced run, isolate one worktree for product work or a bounded set for self-improvement, execute each agent, evaluate gates, measure each committed candidate against the claimed Git base, rank eligible self-improvement candidates by the verified quality vectors, revalidate, and promote at most one candidate inside the controller-owned operation boundary
reconciliation.repeat_condition: Repeat while eligible work exists; re-observe after each state change, restart, timeout, or external change

dispatch_revalidation.boundary: Immediately before worktree creation and agent dispatch
dispatch_revalidation.fresh_read: Read controller ownership, the SPEC digest, and the base Git commit again and compare them with the current controller and claim
deny_conditions: Another current controller owns the state database and base repository
The controller owner, repository, generation, or lease time is not current
The run generation is not current
The base repository has uncommitted changes

retries_timeouts.retry_policy: Each child heartbeat revalidates the full SPEC digest and base commit before it renews controller ownership and revalidates the run generation and run lease time; a failed or stale item returns to ready until its configured attempt limit is reached
retries_timeouts.backoff: The current local controller retries on a later explicit reconciliation cycle; time-based exponential backoff is not implemented
timeouts: The agent process has a configured wall-clock timeout
Each verification gate has a configured wall-clock timeout
Each self-improvement candidate has a configured combined agent-and-gate process-time limit
The controller ownership lease has a configured wall-clock expiration
The run lease has a configured wall-clock expiration

restart_stale_events.restart_behavior: A replacement controller waits for the current ownership lease to expire, acquires a higher controller generation, expires old nonterminal run leases, preserves their artifacts, and creates a new run generation only on a later claim
restart_stale_events.fencing_token: The controller owner and monotonically increasing controller generation fence scheduling and promotion; the run id and monotonically increasing per-item generation fence run events
restart_stale_events.stale_event_disposition: Reject the state change and retain the prior durable event history

preservation_cleanup.semantic_condition: The run is executing, evaluating, promoting, failed, or stale
preservation_cleanup.artifact_action: Preserve each worktree, candidate commit, gate vector, Git change-surface vector, ranking, decision, and result summary
preservation_cleanup.revalidation: Read the durable run state before any future cleanup

preservation_cleanup.semantic_condition: The run succeeded and the promoted commit is reachable from the base branch
preservation_cleanup.artifact_action: Remove the successful worktree and its merged branch when configured
preservation_cleanup.revalidation: Confirm terminal success, path containment, clean state, candidate identity, reachability, and Git worktree registration

preservation_cleanup.semantic_condition: Artifact ownership or semantic disposition is uncertain
preservation_cleanup.revalidation: Require new authoritative evidence before changing disposition

human_handoff.entry: Enter handoff when automatic promotion is disabled, policy blocks progress, repeated attempts reach the limit, or an external authority decision is required
human_handoff.stability: Keep the SPEC, run record, events, candidate worktree, base commit, and failed gate evidence unchanged
human_handoff.resumption: Change the authoritative SPEC or policy, then run a new reconciliation cycle that creates a new lease generation

states.name: ready
states.owner: SQLite projection of the current SPEC
states.entry: A current SPEC item is new, changed after achievement, or returned from a failed or stale attempt
states.exit: A current generation claims the item, the SPEC removes it, or the attempt limit blocks it
states.revalidation: Re-read the item, canonical item digest, attempt count, full SPEC digest, and absence of a current lease during the claim transaction
states.retry_timeout: Remain ready until a later cycle; do not exceed the attempt limit
states.disposal: Preserve the item and its prior evidence

states.name: active
states.entry: A claim transaction creates a leased run
states.exit: The current run succeeds, fails, becomes stale, or policy blocks it
states.revalidation: Check current run id, generation, expected state, and lease time for each event
states.retry_timeout: Expire the lease and return the item to ready
states.restart: Recover from the durable lease and run record
states.disposal: Preserve all run artifacts while active

states.name: achieved
states.entry: A promoting run records a successful fast-forward commit
states.revalidation: Confirm the promoted commit and current canonical work-item digest
states.retry_timeout: No retry while the item remains achieved for the same canonical work-item revision
states.disposal: Preserve compact evidence; terminal worktree becomes cleanup-eligible

states.name: blocked
states.entry: The attempt limit or an authority boundary prevents an automatic action
states.exit: An authoritative SPEC or policy revision supplies a safe resumption route
states.revalidation: Read the policy, attempt count, and unresolved evidence
states.retry_timeout: Do not retry automatically while blocked
states.restart: Retain the block reason and artifacts

states.name: superseded
states.entry: A prior nonterminal item is absent from the current SPEC
states.exit: A later SPEC adds the id again
states.revalidation: Compare all stored ids with the current parsed SPEC

states.name: leased
states.owner: Current controller generation and claim transaction in SQLite
states.entry: The current controller selects an eligible ready item under an immediate transaction
states.exit: Fresh reads allow execution, or changed state makes the claim stale
states.revalidation: Compare controller ownership, SPEC digest, base commit, run generation, and run lease before dispatch
states.retry_timeout: Lease expiration makes the run stale
states.restart: Recover or expire the durable lease

states.name: executing
states.owner: Reconciler with a bounded agent child process
states.entry: Worktree creation succeeds and the current lease transitions from leased
states.exit: Agent failure goes to failed; agent success goes to evaluating
states.revalidation: Each heartbeat and the child-completion boundary compare the full SPEC digest and base commit, then renew controller ownership and validate the run generation and run lease time
states.retry_timeout: A current heartbeat renews controller and run leases; agent timeout or authority loss stops the child and fails or stales the run
states.restart: An expired lease makes the run stale; preserve the worktree
states.disposal: Preserve the worktree and bounded result summary

states.name: evaluating
states.entry: The product agent exits successfully or the bounded self-improvement candidate agents finish under the current lease
states.exit: Any failed gate fails product work; self-improvement measures committed Git change surfaces, verifies deterministic ranking, and continues only with one all-pass non-regressing winner
states.revalidation: Each heartbeat and gate-completion boundary compare the full SPEC digest and base commit, then renew controller ownership and validate the run generation and run lease time before recording a gate result; SQLite verifies each quality vector and rank before selection
states.retry_timeout: A current heartbeat renews controller and run leases; gate timeout or authority loss stops the child and fails or stales the run
states.restart: An expired lease makes the run stale; preserve results
states.disposal: Preserve gate output, committed quality vectors, deterministic ranks, and the promotion decision

states.name: promoting
states.owner: Reconciler with the current controller owner token and generation
states.entry: All product gates pass, or one ranked self-improvement candidate is all-pass and non-regressing, and fresh SPEC and base-commit reads match the claim
states.exit: Fast-forward success reaches succeeded; Git invariant failure reaches failed
states.revalidation: Validate controller ownership and read the base commit immediately before fast-forward merge; hold the SQLite ownership transaction during promotion
states.retry_timeout: Do not retry a promotion after base movement without a new generation
states.restart: Re-observe Git reachability and durable state before any action

states.name: succeeded
states.owner: SQLite state store after observed Git success
states.entry: Fast-forward promotion returns the promoted commit
states.revalidation: Confirm the promoted commit is reachable before later cleanup
states.disposal: Retain compact evidence; remove the worktree only after all semantic cleanup checks pass

states.name: awaiting-promotion
states.owner: SQLite state store after all gates pass under manual-promotion policy
states.entry: The candidate is committed, all gates pass without mutation, fresh reads match, and automatic promotion is disabled
states.exit: Terminal handoff state until an authorized future resumption command creates a new transition
states.revalidation: Confirm candidate commit, base commit, SPEC digest, and blocked work item before resumption
states.retry_timeout: Do not expire or retry automatically
states.restart: Retain the candidate, blocked item, and handoff detail

states.name: failed
states.entry: Agent, gate, Git, or policy execution fails under the current lease
states.exit: Terminal run; the item can receive a new generation if attempts remain
states.revalidation: Record failure only for the current generation and expected state
states.retry_timeout: A later cycle can retry within the attempt limit
states.disposal: Preserve the candidate until an explicit semantic cleanup decision

states.name: stale
states.owner: SQLite state store after authority loss
states.entry: The lease expires, the generation is not current, or a fresh SPEC or base-commit observation differs from the claim
states.exit: Terminal run; a later claim uses a higher generation
states.revalidation: Compare run id, generation, expected state, lease, SPEC digest, and base commit
states.retry_timeout: A later cycle can retry within the attempt limit
states.restart: Retain stale state and reject late events
states.disposal: Preserve candidate and bounded authority-loss event history

lifecycle_tests.sequence: sync SPEC, claim item, attempt transition with a different generation
lifecycle_tests.transition: ready to active; leased event rejection
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Use a stale generation
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: The current run remains unchanged and the stale event is rejected
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: SQLite run row and test assertion

lifecycle_tests.sequence: claim item, change SPEC, revalidate before worktree creation
lifecycle_tests.transition: leased to stale
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Change the SPEC digest after claim
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: No agent dispatch occurs
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Stale run detail and absence of an executing transition

lifecycle_tests.sequence: execute agent, run a failing gate, inspect base branch
lifecycle_tests.transition: evaluating to failed
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Return a nonzero gate exit
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: The base commit does not change and the candidate remains preserved
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Gate event, failed run, candidate worktree, and unchanged Git commit

lifecycle_tests.sequence: pass gates, move base commit, attempt promotion
lifecycle_tests.transition: evaluating to stale or promoting to failed
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Advance the base after the claim
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: Fast-forward promotion is refused
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Run detail and unchanged candidate reachability

lifecycle_tests.sequence: expire a nonterminal lease, restart the store, claim again
lifecycle_tests.transition: executing to stale; ready to active with a higher generation
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Controller process loss
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: Evidence remains and late events from the old generation fail
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Two run rows, increasing generation, and preserved events

lifecycle_tests.sequence: commit a candidate, pass all gates, disable automatic promotion
lifecycle_tests.transition: promoting to awaiting-promotion
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Policy denies automatic promotion
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: The verified candidate and evidence remain stable without lease expiry
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Awaiting-promotion run, blocked item, and preserved worktree

lifecycle_tests.sequence: run an agent longer than the original lease and complete all gates
lifecycle_tests.transition: executing with repeated lease renewal to evaluating and succeeded
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Agent duration exceeds the original lease duration
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: The current generation retains authority and can promote the verified candidate
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Renewed lease time, succeeded run, and promoted commit

lifecycle_tests.sequence: claim an item, change the SPEC or base commit, then reach the dispatch boundary
lifecycle_tests.transition: leased to stale
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Desired state changes after the claim transaction
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: No worktree or agent process is dispatched
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Stale run detail and dispatch test assertions

lifecycle_tests.sequence: start a long agent, change the full SPEC digest, and wait for its next heartbeat
lifecycle_tests.transition: executing to stale
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Change desired-state authority while the child is active
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: The child stops before candidate creation, evaluation, or promotion
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Stale run, spec-digest-changed authority event, preserved worktree, and absence of evaluation

lifecycle_tests.sequence: start a long agent, advance the base commit, and wait for its next heartbeat
lifecycle_tests.transition: executing to stale
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Change source authority while the child is active
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: The child stops before candidate creation, evaluation, or promotion
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Stale run, base-commit-changed authority event, preserved worktree, and absence of evaluation

lifecycle_tests.sequence: promote a verified candidate, record success, then clean its worktree
lifecycle_tests.transition: promoting to succeeded and terminal cleanup
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Make the successful worktree dirty before cleanup
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: Clean reachable worktrees are removed; dirty or uncertain worktrees are preserved
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Terminal cleanup event, Git worktree registry, and cleanup tests

lifecycle_tests.sequence: run baseline gates, dispatch self-improvement, then run candidate gates
lifecycle_tests.transition: leased baseline evaluation through normal execution and candidate evaluation
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Make a baseline gate fail and the candidate gate pass
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: Record an improvement classification with a positive pass delta and preserve both gate vectors
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Baseline, candidate, and measured self-improvement evaluation events

lifecycle_tests.sequence: run the same failing gate against the baseline and self-improvement candidate
lifecycle_tests.transition: leased baseline evaluation through failed candidate evaluation
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Keep the observed gate failing in both evaluations
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: Record no improvement with a zero pass delta instead of a false regression
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Baseline, candidate, measured evaluation, failed run, and preserved worktree

lifecycle_tests.sequence: create three isolated self-improvement candidates from one base, give two eligible candidates exact quality ties, and fail the third
lifecycle_tests.transition: executing through deterministic ranking, promoting, and succeeded
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Give the first two eligible candidates equal changed-line and changed-file counts
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: Ascending candidate ID breaks the exact quality tie, selects only candidate-001, and promotes only that candidate
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Three candidate rows, complete gate and quality vectors, deterministic ranks, one selected row, promotion decision, promoted commit, and preserved non-winner worktrees

lifecycle_tests.sequence: create three all-pass self-improvement candidates with unequal committed change surfaces
lifecycle_tests.transition: executing through deterministic ranking, promoting, and succeeded
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Give candidates different changed-line counts and an equal-line pair with different changed-file counts
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: Fewer changed lines rank first, fewer changed files break the line-count tie, and only the best eligible candidate is promoted
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Committed Git comparisons, constrained SQLite quality vectors, deterministic ranks, one selection, and the promoted smallest change surface

lifecycle_tests.sequence: measure an all-pass candidate, replace its total changed lines with an inconsistent value, and attempt ranking
lifecycle_tests.transition: evaluating to failed before ranking or promotion
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Return a changed-line total that does not equal insertions plus deletions
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: SQLite rejects the vector and the controller records no rank or promotion decision
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Failed run, unchanged base commit, unranked candidate row, absent promotion decision, and SQLite constraint assertion

lifecycle_tests.sequence: run two self-improvement agents longer than the configured candidate process-time limit
lifecycle_tests.transition: executing through ranked evaluation to failed
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Exhaust each candidate budget before candidate commit and gates
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: Both candidates time out, no candidate is eligible, and Git promotion does not occur
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Two timed-out candidate rows, zero scores, deterministic ranks, no-eligible-candidate decision, and unchanged base commit

lifecycle_tests.sequence: achieve one item, add an unrelated item, then change the achieved item
lifecycle_tests.transition: achieved remains achieved, then achieved returns to ready
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Change the full SPEC digest without changing the first item, then change its canonical item digest
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: Unrelated desired work does not reopen the item, but an item revision does
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: SQLite item states and focused state-store assertions

lifecycle_tests.sequence: load a legacy achieved row whose item digest is the current full SPEC digest, then sync canonical item identity
lifecycle_tests.transition: achieved remains achieved during identity migration
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Replace the stored legacy full-file digest with the canonical item digest
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: The current achieved item stays achieved and later changes use its individual identity
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: SQLite stored digest, achieved state, and migration assertion

lifecycle_tests.sequence: start one controller, dispatch a long agent, then start a second controller against the same state database and base repository
lifecycle_tests.transition: controller ownership remains with the first generation
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Attempt concurrent controller acquisition while the first ownership lease is current
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: The second controller is deferred and cannot create a run or reach promotion
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Controller acquisition events, one run row, deferred outcome, and concurrency assertions

lifecycle_tests.sequence: acquire controller ownership, simulate controller loss, wait past lease expiry, then start a replacement controller
lifecycle_tests.transition: expired controller generation to a higher current generation
lifecycle_tests.failure_injection: Controller process loss without graceful lease release
lifecycle_tests.expected_semantic_outcome: The replacement controller acquires ownership and completes reconciliation
lifecycle_tests.durable_evidence: Increasing controller acquisition generations, expired lease status, and recovered successful run
